topic: Hashrate is your share of the lottery
hook: Your hashrate is really your share of a lottery.

scenes.narration: Your chance of finding a block is your share of the total network hashrate.
Twice the share means twice the chance. But it is still chance.
Pools share rewards in proportion to the work contributed, which smooths out the payouts.

cta: How big is your share? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Your Hashrate Is Your Share of the Lottery
description_body: Your chance of finding a block equals your share of network hashrate.
